subject: Finlytics POC: success criteria, timeline & weekly status cadence
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finlytics.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics POC: success criteria, timeline & weekly status cadence

Hi Alex / Priya 

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching a first draft of the POC success criteria and a lightweight test plan so we can align on what "success" looks like and avoid scope creep. Key items pulled from the call: 

- Goals: reduce inference latency for our realtime ranking pipeline (90th pct latency under 180ms) and demonstrate embedding-based reranking improves top-10 relevance by at least +7% (A/B vs baseline).
- Success criteria in attached doc — please review and confirm.
- Suggested timeline: 2-week sandbox + 3-week evaluation (5 weeks total). Start week of Mar 7 if you can provide test data and sandbox access by EOD Mar 4.
- Ownership: Finlytics to provide anonymized test dataset, access to staging cluster, and a primary technical owner. Redwood (me) will coordinate infra, Marcus will handle model/serving config, and Stephanie will support eval metrics and dashboards.

Next steps:
1) Alex — confirm owners and whether Mar 4 access/date works.
2) Finlytics — share a sample of the test dataset (S3 link or Dropbox) and IAM role for access by Mar 4.
3) Redwood — we’ll provision a sandbox GPU node and share runbook + weekly cadence invite.

I’ve attached: Finlytics_POC_Success_Criteria_v1.docx and Finlytics_POC_Test_Plan_MVP.xlsx.

Looking forward — happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow if that helps get things moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A few quick notes: 

- We confirm the goals and the two success metrics (latency and top-10 relevance uplift).
- Timeline: Mar 7 start works for us, as long as we can get sandbox credentials by EOD Mar 4.
- Owners: Priya will be the primary technical owner and will coordinate data access with our infra team. I’ll be the executive sponsor and will join weekly checkpoints.

Priya — I’m looping you in to handle the S3 link and an IAM role for Redwood.
